## Summary

Follows on from PR #41. Three related improvements to the LLM layer:

### 1. Provider chain reordered
Detection now prioritises zero-config CLI tools over API keys:

```
Anthropic API → OpenAI API → OpenAI-compat → Gemini API →
Claude Code CLI → Copilot CLI → Gemini CLI → Ollama (last resort)
```

Claude Code CLI probe uses the `Claude Code-credentials` macOS keychain entry (not just `which claude`), so it only activates when actually logged in.
